policy: Each record preserves a short source excerpt for reading and supplies a separate conservative performance adaptation. The tones express only matched canonical meanings; unsupported story detail remains visible in English or as a nonsemantic phonemic label.

presets.title: Remember the carriers
presets.explanation: After the feast, Brindle replaces self-credit with a shared work notice and finally carries something for Tavi. The moment turns hospitality into reciprocal care.
source_excerpt: Brindle: Meals for one another. Please include the people who carry them.
Tavi enters carrying nothing while Brindle holds the door.
presets.performance_note: The performance preserves beginning, active care, people, present location, and acting together. Era Zero does not claim a dedicated atomic meaning for meals or carrying here.

performance_turns.speaker: Tavi
performance_turns.english: Please help the people who carry the meals.

presets.title: Use the present bank
presets.source_section: High water: experiment / Falling water: the tool
presets.explanation: Pell asks Suth to guide the rescue by the bank that exists now, not by a persuasive old reflection. Their trust becomes a practical method for surviving uncertain evidence.
source_excerpt: Pell: The present bank, Suth. I need the present bank.
Suth: Left. The root is yours. The stone isn't.
presets.performance_note: The tones preserve need, current position, route, active joint movement, and a living person. They do not encode the reflected bank, the root, or the deceptive stone as special atoms.

presets.story: Lamentations for the Rooms We Did Not Carry
presets.title: Keep the objections beside one another
presets.source_section: III. Palinode's objection / V. Serein declines an arithmetic consolation
presets.explanation: Palinode and Serein refuse to have distinct objections merged into a tidier history. Later, Serein redirects attention from proving an origin toward making a wall and a latch that work now.
source_excerpt: Palinode: I will attach your objection to mine.
Serein: Yes. I heard you. Now help me place this wall.
presets.performance_note: The performance preserves preservation, data retention, assistance, placement, and a present task. Objection and wall remain referential labels rather than newly invented roots.

presets.title: Arrival is not consent
presets.explanation: Nacre challenges a station that counts reaching its hall as a completed journey. Ilex and Varo finally reopen a live exchange so the receiving bed—and the travelers themselves—can answer.
source_excerpt: Nacre: I need the low-water gate.
Varo: You are already at your destination.
Nacre: No, I am at your station.
Ilex: We need a live receiving exchange.
presets.performance_note: The tones contrast need, destination, current position, receiving, and a continuing presence. Low-water, station procedure, consent, and the exact guests remain explicit English detail.

performance_turns.speaker: Nacre
performance_turns.english: No. My current position is your station. We need a live receiving exchange.

performance_turns.speaker: Varo
performance_turns.english: I will stay until you answer.

presets.title: Ask who is using it
presets.explanation: Dema discovers a settlement inside material marked for replacement. The rescue succeeds because both scales exchange conditions, preserve rough but useful structures, and wait for an answer before acting.
source_excerpt: Dema: The join will break during heavy rain. I was going to replace the strip below it. Your town appears to be attached to that strip.
Venn: Before replacing this part, ask who is using it. Then wait for the answer.
presets.performance_note: The tones preserve discovery, care rather than cleaning, need, route, waiting as timing structure, arrival, and present location. The town, nursery, rain, and engineering details remain English referents.

performance_turns.speaker: Issa
performance_turns.english: Wait and listen for the answer.
